findings: All 26 production-window captures were reviewed individually: 21 main journey images and five draft recovery images. These runs use the binary installed in ~/Applications/Magistr.app from the native Tauri bundle. Light and dark views keep messages, controls and keyboard focus readable. At 800 × 680 the Send button wraps to its own visible row.

The saved-history dialog retains its scrolling content body and reserved Close action. After refused resume, Close at [1097,885,81,39] is inside the dialog [524,231,680,720] and window [224,159,1280,832]. Native pointer Close, reopen, exact retained text and subsequent Resume pass. Focus can scroll the heading partly out of view; selected context and Close remain usable. Saved-message Save and Discard actions are visible in the recovery capture.

The five draft captures show exact multilingual text, restored source-file selections and clipboard image preview, saved status and focus in both appearances. The narrow attachment list scrolls without hiding Add files, Discard or Send. The failed-save view keeps the message editable after refused Quit and presents Retry guidance. Successful Retry subsequently clears both save and Quit notices.

The draft receipt passes 59 checks across four launches: native Quit, interrupted exit, native Quit and native Quit. Four named conversations cover two working copies and two providers. A final edit followed by Quit after 28.23 ms reopens intact; 32 rapid native Unicode edits recover the final revision after interruption. Explicit discard stays durable, appearance and reduced motion restore, normal Quit retains each conversation's spending record, and recovery sends no unintended prompt.

The attachment captures show image previews, names, sizes, removal and a text preview disclosure. Native picker selection and cancellation, clipboard images, file-URL drag, exact text/image delivery, and changed/missing/unsupported file refusal pass. Removing the unsupported image preserves the original text file for explicit Send.

Rich views show headings, emphasis, quotes, lists, code, multilingual text and visible link focus. Unsupported pipe-table syntax remains plain selectable text. A long code line clips within the narrow pane; horizontal code scrolling was not exercised. Authored HTML and unsafe links stay literal, and remote images make no request.

Native selection stays exactly 'Native selection café 日本語 👩🏽‍💻.' at [474,402,209,17] while replies and an earlier tool update. Latest clears selection and resumes following. The reading anchor remains stable through further updates; the controlled stream finishes with 133 chunks. Reply copying preserves 11,321 UTF-8 bytes and conversation copying preserves 21,864 bytes. Native keyboard link activation reaches the controlled localhost destination in Firefox and closes only that test tab.

Known issues remain assigned to native accessibility work: Latest reply overlaps text or Copy message in some captures, Choose model touches the Agent focus ring, and unavailable-provider/refused-resume guidance includes nested technical error chains. These checks do not claim those issues are resolved.

The main receipt passes 170 checks with seven settled logical histories and 97.35 ms keyboard-to-accessible-reply latency. This run observed Japanese Kana preedit and committed 'ミニくらみ' as an unsent draft. VoiceOver was not running. The result does not establish spoken-reader usability, reliable IME activation, candidate panels, Romanization, Chinese or Korean input, high-contrast behavior, Linux parity or a whole-application performance budget.
